analysis:
The supplied units are CHANGELOG.md head text only (lines 318-799); no executable source was supplied. I examined the entries for security-relevant claims against the threat model (T-041 cache, TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-011, A-008 token custody, A-016 authorization).

Notable documented behaviors that the next pass should verify against the actual code (not provided here): (1) line 325 describes a DEBUG-only `DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE` path for a persistent cache key, stated as absent from release builds; this must be compiled out of release configurations, since a file-based key would weaken the SE-rooted KEK for the T-041 cache. (2) Line 327 changes weight hashing to F_NOCACHE reads before and after load; digests are unchanged, but the pre/post-load hash flow (T-012/T-027) should be confirmed to still fail closed. (3) Lines 462 and 330 add retained KV segments and early-503 capacity refusals; retained segments are zero-fill-on-demand host pages, so confirm no cross-request residual data exposure (T-028). (4) Line 326 accepts reasoning/thinking controls; the fixed local error messages carry no prompt content. (5) Lines 546-560 add a staging environment and relax the installer signature check for `-dev.` and `-staging.` versions, accepting ad-hoc signatures. This is limited to pre-release versions with the bundle identifier pinned; the version-string gate should be reviewed so that a production install cannot be downgraded or spoofed into the relaxed path (T-013/T-034). The changelog says the fan helper still requires an Apple-signed build. (6) Lines 554 and 764 describe automatic official release registration, with prod tag-gated and verified signed tags; the pipeline code is not supplied.

No findings: these are documentation statements, and I found no evidence in the supplied text of an implemented regression. The Cmlx/MLX pin changes and prompt-contract v9 cache-scope mismatch (line 6 area in the patch excerpt) fail to ordinary no-cache serving rather than cross-scope reuse, per the stated design. Code-level verification is needed, hence needs_deeper_review is set.
